units.source_text: “K没完没了地追问有关夫人和小姐的事情，甚至还问到一些我也回答不了的问题。

en.t: K kept questioning me endlessly about Madam and the young lady, and even asked things that I could not answer.

units.source_text: 我感到厌烦，更觉得不可思议。

en.t: I felt annoyed, and even more than that, I found it strange.

units.source_text: 一想到以前聊天时，我提起她们时K的表情，我就不能不注意到他的变化了。

en.t: When I thought back to K's expression in earlier conversations when I had brought them up, I could not help noticing how he had changed.

units.source_text: 我终于忍不住问他，今天为什么老是谈这些事时，他突然沉默了。

en.t: At last I could not hold back and asked him why he kept talking about such things today, and he suddenly fell silent.

units.source_text: 但是我注意到，他紧闭的嘴角似乎在颤动。

en.t: But I noticed that the corners of his tightly closed mouth seemed to be trembling.

units.source_text: 他是个沉默寡言的人，而且他有个毛病，每当要说什么话的时候，嘴唇总是会不受控制地抽搐起来。

en.t: He was a man of few words, and he had a habit that whenever he was about to say something, his lips would twitch beyond his control.

units.source_text: 他的嘴唇仿佛在故意反抗他的意志，不肯轻易打开，因此他说出来的话也加重了分量吧。

en.t: It was as if his lips deliberately resisted his will and would not open easily, and perhaps that gave extra weight to the words he finally spoke.

units.source_text: 一旦破口而出，他的声音会比一般人的声音有力一倍。

en.t: Once his voice burst out, it carried twice the force of an ordinary person's voice.

units.source_text: 只需看一眼他的嘴唇，我便马上察觉到他又要说什么了，但他到底准备说出什么话来，我却没有一点预感。

en.t: With just one glance at his lips, I immediately sensed that he was about to say something again, but I had no idea at all what he was preparing to say.

units.source_text: 因此，听了以后，我惊呆了。

en.t: That was why, after hearing it, I was stunned.

units.source_text: 请你想象一下，从他那沉重的嘴里，吐露出他对小姐的相思之苦时，我是怎样的表情吧。

en.t: Please imagine what my expression must have been when that heavy mouth of his revealed the pain of his love for the young lady.

units.source_text: 我就像是被他的魔棒打成了化石一般，连张嘴的能力都丧失了。

en.t: I was as though his magic wand had turned me into stone, and I had even lost the ability to open my mouth.
